releaseNotes:
• Tied all data usage metrics and date filters strictly to Router/VPS MMT clock (Asia/Yangon UTC+6:30) independent of phone clock
• Fixed sales revenue calculation: each voucher counted exactly once on first activation
• Airtight 1-day voucher lifetime lockout while preserving 30-day vouchers 100%
• Captive portal mixed-case character input (0-9, a-z, A-Z) without keyboard locking
